def: Google DeepMind's family of natively multimodal models, first announced in December 2023 and offered in tiers such as Pro, Flash and Flash-Lite.
practice: As of November 2026 the flagship is Gemini 4 Argon (generally available October 2026) alongside Gemini 3.x Pro, Flash and Flash-Lite; check each model's stable, preview or experimental label before production use.
